n Medical University, Dalian 116033, China;2.School of Basic Medicine, Shenyang Medical College, Shenyang 110034, China;3.School of Pharmacy, Dalian Medical University, Dalian 116044, China[Abstract] Objective To establish a sensitive, effective and specific high performance liquid chromatography -mass spectrometry to determine the concentration of ubenimex and methotrexate in the biological samples. Methods The biological samples were all treated by acetonitrile protein precipitation in the two methods of LC-MS/MS, Hypersil ODS-C18 was applied in the column chromatographical separation, and the spectrum was seriesly connected by electronic spray ion source. The negative iron was detected by multiple-reaction monitoring and the concentration of ubenimex and methotrexate in the biological sample was determined. m/z 309.10 → m/z 120.30, m/z 455.20→ m/z 308.20 and m/z 370.40→m/z 288.10 were taken as the monitored iron pairs of ubenimex, methotrexate and cilostazol(internal marker) during quantification analysis. The mobile phase of chromatograph was acetonitrile -0.1% formic acid water (60:40, =v/v) and the flow velocity was 0.4 mL/min. Results The linear correlation of ubenimex and methotrexate in 2.00-2000 ng/mL was good (r 2 =0.9976). Conclusion The established LC-MS/MS is rapid, sensitive and specific, which is suitable for the clinical pharmacokinetic study of ubenimex and methotrexate.肿瘤是一类严重危害人类健康的多发病常见病化疗在癌症综合治疗中处于不可缺少的重要地位为了提高化疗的疗效医学工作者开展了多方面的研究如开发新的高效低毒的药物更科学合理联合用药以协同增效等其中联合用药是临床上长期使用且合理有效的治疗手段所以药物相互作用（ drug-drug-interaction DDI ） 是长期困扰临床治疗的问题之一[1] P-糖蛋白 $\left( \mathrm { P - g p } \right)$ ）影响药物代谢动力学及口服生物利用度临床上许多的癌症化疗药物是 P-糖蛋白的底物都被它所外排[2，3] 有机阴离子转运体（ organic anion transporter OATs ） 将血液中的有机阴离子转运至肾小管上皮细胞内 OATs 能够转运一些内源性阴离子代谢物及某些有机阴离子药物[4-6] 甲氨蝶呤（MTX）是治疗肿瘤和一些自身免疫性疾病的有效的抗癌药物近些年来有报告指出甲氨蝶呤的多药耐药与药物相互作用常与 P-gp 和 OATs有关[7-9] 乌苯美司（bestatin）是临床上常用的一种免疫增强剂用于配合其它化疗药物的治疗当甲氨蝶呤与乌苯美司合用时这些转运体是否影响二者体内动态和临床疗效也不明确[10-12] 因此本实验目的是建立灵敏高效的 LC-MS/MS 检测方法阐明甲氨蝶呤和乌苯美司相互作用分子药代学机制▲通讯作者
